title: Build MCP Server: Claude Code Skill for MCP Development

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill's key features list reports 1 GitHub star for the listing.
The Build MCP Server skill is listed in the API Development category on MCPMarket.
The Build MCP Server skill provides framework guidance for the Official TypeScript SDK and FastMCP Python.
facts.quote: Comprehensive framework guidance for Official TypeScript SDK and FastMCP Python

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill's discovery phase chooses among three deployment models: Remote HTTP, MCPB, or stdio.
facts.quote: Architectural discovery to pick the right deployment model (Remote HTTP, MCPB, or stdio)

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill includes best-practice implementation guidance for OAuth 2.0, CIMD, and DCR authentication.
facts.quote: Best-practice implementation for OAuth 2.0, CIMD, and DCR authentication

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill supports a 'Search + Execute' tool-design pattern for large API surfaces.
facts.quote: Support for multiple tool-design patterns like 'Search + Execute' for large API surfaces

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill is intended for wrapping cloud-based SaaS APIs to expose tools and resources to Claude.
facts.quote: Wrapping a cloud-based SaaS API to expose tools and resources to Claude

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill is intended for building local desktop integrations that interact with the filesystem or local apps.
facts.quote: Building local desktop integrations that interact with the filesystem or local apps

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill supports native elicitation and UI widget (MCP app) integration.
facts.quote: Native elicitation and UI widget (MCP app) integration support

facts.fact: The Build MCP Server skill can be installed with the command 'npx skillfish add quochieudn2303/claude-plugins-official-copilot build-mcp-server'.
